boards.title: Your First Weekend at Otterbein University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: An under-21-safe first-weekend sequence using documented campus spaces, activities, and Westerville destinations.

cards.title: 1. Get oriented with the campus map
cards.subtitle: Start at 1 S. Grove St., Westerville
cards.notes: Open the interactive map, locate your residence hall and the Campus Center, then save the route you will use for your first classes.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a practical map check before exploring.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein’s campus-map page provides an interactive map and identifies its main campus address as 1 South Grove Street, Westerville.
cards.source_title: Campus Map and Directions | Otterbein University
cards.access_notes: Use the university map’s building filters and marker details.

cards.title: 2. Walk to Towers Hall
cards.subtitle: 1 S. Grove St., on the Otterbein campus
cards.notes: Use the map to find Towers Hall, pause to recognize the building, and use it as a landmark while learning the central campus paths.
cards.short_summary: Make a historic campus landmark your navigation anchor.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein identifies Towers Hall at 1 South Grove Street; its campus-life page describes it as a National Historic Building.
cards.source_title: Top Places to Hang Out on Campus | Otterbein University
cards.access_notes: Exterior walk-up landmark; follow posted campus access guidance.

cards.title: 3. Find the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Center, Otterbein University
cards.notes: Walk through the Campus Center to identify the dining floors and meeting areas, so you know where to reconnect with classmates later.
cards.short_summary: Locate a central hub for food and campus activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein lists both The Nest and OtterDen in the Campus Center, on its second and first floors respectively.
cards.source_title: Dining Options at Otterbein | Otterbein University
cards.access_notes: Building access and dining availability may vary with the academic calendar.

cards.title: 4. Share a meal at The Nest
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Campus Center
cards.notes: Choose a meal time with new classmates and look over the food-station options; confirm meal-plan eligibility or prices before ordering.
cards.short_summary: Use the main dining and social space for an easy group meal.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein describes The Nest, on the Campus Center’s second floor, as its main dining and socializing spot with six food stations.
cards.source_title: Dining Options at Otterbein | Otterbein University
cards.access_notes: A Cardinal Card is used at campus dining locations; food requires an applicable meal plan or payment.

cards.title: 5. Visit the Frank Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 39 S. Vine St., Westerville
cards.notes: Check the museum’s current exhibition information, then take a quiet loop through the galleries and note an artwork you want to revisit.
cards.short_summary: Add an on-campus art stop to the afternoon.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein’s campus map lists The Frank Museum of Art at 39 South Vine Street, and its campus-life page identifies it among campus art venues.
cards.source_title: Campus Map and Directions | Otterbein University
cards.access_notes: Confirm current museum opening and exhibition access before going.

cards.title: 6. Check the Miller Gallery program
cards.subtitle: Otterbein campus art gallery
cards.notes: Look for the current public exhibition, workshop, or lecture listing and make a plan to return with a friend during the term.
cards.short_summary: Use a campus gallery to find an arts event or exhibition.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein states that the Miller Gallery presents public exhibitions and may include artist workshops or lectures.
cards.source_title: Top Places to Hang Out on Campus | Otterbein University
cards.access_notes: Public-exhibition timing varies; verify the current program before visiting.

cards.title: 7. Take a recreation-center lap
cards.subtitle: 180 Center St., beside the Rike Center
cards.notes: Bring your active Cardinal Card, ask the front desk about entry, and try a low-key walk on the indoor track or a court activity.
cards.short_summary: Use Cardinal Card access to learn the recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein says active Cardinal Card holders may use the Clements Recreation & Fitness Center and Rike Center free of charge; Clements includes an indoor track and courts.
cards.access_notes: Current Cardinal Card required; posted hours list Saturday 10 a.m.–7 p.m. and Sunday noon–10 p.m., subject to holidays and summer changes.

cards.title: 8. See what is happening at Rike Center
cards.subtitle: 160 Center St., Westerville
cards.notes: Check the event calendar for a game, match, or special event, then attend only the activity that fits your schedule and access status.
cards.short_summary: Use a multipurpose athletics venue as an event-calendar stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein says the Rike Center hosts basketball, volleyball, wrestling, and other special events, and its campus map lists the building at 160 Center Street.
cards.access_notes: Event access, ticketing, and start times vary; verify the specific listing before attending.

cards.title: 9. Reserve a theatre or dance ticket
cards.subtitle: Cowan Hall, 30 S. Grove St.
cards.notes: Review the current production calendar and reserve through the student process with your Cardinal Card rather than assuming walk-up availability.
cards.short_summary: Plan an arts evening with documented student ticket access.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein states that full-time students receive free tickets to mainstage theatre and dance productions during the academic year, reservable with a valid Cardinal Card.
cards.source_title: Theatre & Dance Performances at Otterbein University
cards.access_notes: Production dates and reservation availability vary; student tickets require a valid Cardinal Card.

cards.title: 10. Pick one campus event for Sunday
cards.subtitle: Use the centralized online calendar
cards.notes: Filter by building or event type, choose a public campus activity that fits your interests, and confirm its time and attendance details before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Finish by turning the calendar into a low-pressure plan.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein’s centralized events calendar includes university, student, art, theatre, and music events and can be filtered by type, topic, or building.
cards.access_notes: Each event sets its own attendance requirements and timing; confirm the individual listing.
